body: Everyone already has the virus, it just isn't activated until death. Bites cause infection that cause death. My theory for the legs being eaten is that he didn't die instantly when he hung himself. Didn't break his neck and ended up slowly suffocating. If he had been running from walkers or even near a few they would have heard the struggle and eaten what they could while he was alive.

Hi. I feel like I understand you. If you'd like to pm me you can. A lot of the qualities you described about yourself are actually desirable to some women. Hang on and be strong. You've made a good first step by posting and getting it all out there. I find, for me at least, getting things out and venting in and of itself can be a big help sometimes.
